title: Sepahsalar Mosque

terrainReference.basis: Original elevation at the center of the mapped open courtyard under the pool.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap named Motahhari mosque dome, court and streets, with overlapping Overture summer hall outline
mapIdentity.scope: OpenStreetMap’s named Motahhari dome, exact adjacent park quadrilateral and public street edges locate the court, dome and western gate. A distinct Overture roof polygon surrounds the mapped dome. Other roof runs and portals are fitted to the mapped court using the published descriptions.

note: Archnet and Arel describe the four iwans, six courtyard minarets with two more at the west entrance, tiled slender brick shafts, low dome, arcaded dormitory ranges, northeastern clock, and cross-shaped summer prayer hall. The Rietberg photograph establishes open balustraded minaret lanterns and profiles of vaults and pointed openings.
